Resolves #21816

Eight routes that earn impressions with zero clicks now carry a `seoDescription` that states what the page answers. Before, their snippet was the opening line, often a scene ("On a normal night here…") or what the page is not ("Traditional end-to-end testing treats…"). Each description is one sentence of front-matter built from the page's own text. Titles, H1s and body copy are unchanged, so #20917's identity cluster is untouched.

Evidence: L2 (generator output plus `verify.mjs` on a regenerated `seo.json`) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2). The served snippet is Post-Merge Validation: it arrives with the cut's regenerated `seo.json`.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 a `seoDescription` per page, every claim from the page | The eight files' front-matter. Each claim's source is in the page, for example "5.21 GiB" in the repo-split post and "connects to the truth about them" in the Fleet Manager guide. |
| AC-2 regenerated `seo.json` carries them, `verify.mjs` passes | Outside-CI: `generate.mjs -f seo-json -o apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` changed exactly 8 lines, the eight descriptions. `verify.mjs` exited 0 on that file. |

## Deltas from ticket
- `StateProviders.md` also loses trailing whitespace on four lines, which the pre-commit whitespace check requires for any file a commit touches.
- `learn/benefits/Introduction.md` refreshes its front-door fingerprint (`check-front-door-fingerprint.mjs --fix`), because the new front-matter changed its declared bytes and lines, and the `baseline / guards` job checks them.
- `seo.json` itself is not committed: `prepare` writes it into the release commit (#21809), and #21811 edits it too. Until then, a local `verify.mjs` on `dev` reports the tracked file behind, as after any guide change.

## Test Evidence
Generator read-back of the eight routes, then `verify.mjs`, exit 0. A first run without `-o` printed to stdout and left the old file in place, so its read-back showed the old descriptions. The receipt above comes from the rerun with `-o`.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After the Engine 14 cut and its SSR wave, Googlebot reads each route's new description on neomjs.com.
